description: The Region of Emilia-Romagna publishes the PAL_Palo class of its regional topographic database. The full source definition covers simple poles made of wood or other material, excluding lattice structures and structures with substantial cross-sections. Each pole is represented as a point feature. The grouped resource retains DBTR2008, DBTR2013 and the later unqualified DBTR metadata entry as editions of the same named class. They are not treated as three independent asset populations. The lineage says that topographic geometry is combined with attributes from regional CGU layers; the 2008 edition refers to CGU version 2010. Current metadata lists Shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, DXF, KMZ and geodatabase representations, plus map services. These descriptions establish small built structures but do not identify their service function, connected networks, structural capacity, condition or current operating status. No electricity, telecommunications or lighting role is inferred. Specific simulation uses remain unknown. Native records state CC BY 4.0 and no public-access limitation. The metadata dates span 2014 to 2021 and are not treated as feature observation dates. No file, feature or map body was read.
